title: FIFA Women's World Cup 2023
description:
Germany vs. Morocco
Germany plays Morocco at Melbourne Rectangular Stadium in Group H of the 2023 World Cup. Germany won the World Cup in 2003 and 2007, but was eliminated by Sweden in the 2019 quarter-finals. Morocco is one of eight World Cup debutants at this edition.
